summary: Make a user become a fan of an artist
description: Allows the user identified by `user_id` (derived from the access token) to become a fan of the artist identified by `artist_id`. If the artist does not exist, no error is raised but the fan relationship will not appear in read requests. Requires a valid client_id and OAuth2 access token with the `music` scope.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' to the header (performance‑heavy, use only when needed)

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: A valid OAuth2 access token (music scope) for the Jamendo user to be updated

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the artist to become a fan of

notes: If the specified artist does not exist, the request succeeds silently and no fan relationship is created.
`fullcount` can impact performance and is not available on all heavy methods.
